## AuthConfig.logo property

Logo styles.

**Signature:**

```typescript
logo: ComposableStyles | ComposableStyles[] | null;
```

## Remarks

Providing `null` will hide the logo. Use content: url(...); to set source.

## Example 1

Setting a custom logo using a plain template literal

```ts
logo: `
    content: url(${customLogoImport});
`,
```

## Example 2

Setting a custom logo using FASTElement's `css` helper or a pre-created ElementStyles instance when your host app is FAST based

```ts
logo: css`
    content: url(${customLogoImport});
`,
...
logo: LogoElementStyles,
```
